storeInfo.name: Kawa Ni
storeInfo.tagline: Authentic Japanese pub fare & ramen in the heart of Westport | Izakaya auténtico en Westport

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle Bridge St.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or Bridge St street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.nameEs: Edamame Salteado con Ajo y Chile
products.descriptionEs: Vainas de soja tiernas salteadas con ajo crujiente, aceite de chile picante y sal marina.
products.descriptionEn: Tender young soybeans tossed with crispy garlic, chili oil, and sea salt.

products.descriptionEs: Jugosos trozos de pollo marinados y fritos al estilo japonés, servidos con salsa alioli picante de yuzu.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy Japanese-style marinated and crispy fried chicken pieces, served with spicy yuzu aioli.
Pan-seared Japanese dumplings filled with savory pork and chives, served with house ponzu.
Marinated wakame seaweed, thinly sliced Japanese cucumber, and toasted sesame seeds in sweet sesame vinaigrette.
Rich and creamy 24-hour pork bone broth, handcrafted noodles, tender chashu pork, seasoned soft-boiled egg, and scallions.
Clear savory soy sauce-based broth, tender roasted chicken breast, seasoned bamboo shoots, nori, and fresh ramen noodles.
Aromatic shiitake mushroom and kombu broth, vegan noodles, braised tofu, baby bok choy, and a drizzle of black truffle oil.
Savory Japanese cabbage and pork belly pancake, topped with okonomiyaki sauce, Japanese mayo, and dancing bonito flakes.

products.nameEs: Buns de Panceta de Cerdo (Pork Belly Baos)
products.descriptionEn: Two fluffy steamed buns stuffed with melt-in-your-mouth braised pork belly, house pickles, and sweet hoisin-sriracha drizzle.
Glazed salmon fillet with sweet house teriyaki sauce served over a bed of steamed rice with seasonal stir-fried greens.
Premium refined sake with delicate floral and light fruit notes, served chilled.
Traditional cold-brewed Japanese sencha green tea, refreshing and unsweetened.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, disponemos de ramen vegano, edamame y opciones que pueden adaptarse con previo aviso a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegan ramen, edamame, and items that can be modified upon request to your server.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación (walk-ins) y reservaciones por teléfono para grupos pequeños y grandes.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and phone reservations for both small and large parties.
